baseline_source.changes_in_baseline: measurement module/examples and Windows process-metrics feature only; no algorithm/protocol/cache/durability edits

notes: Hosted Windows; disk metadata is runner-reported, not physical owner-PC acceptance; filesystem record refers to SystemDrive rather than proving temporary-fixture volume.
Price server uses portable SQLite: price comparison isolates existing 50/100 page-size effect. Genuine PostgreSQL measurements separately exercise bounded-key optimization.
Actual native retry sleeps; old 5s header reproduced in fixture; candidate route chooses 5s derivation/1s bounded projection.
Automatic timing includes common scope bootstrap, final semantic hash and warm-reuse checks.

Native CPU times have Windows scheduling-clock granularity. RSS is process-lifetime peak, stages are nested inclusive. Missing stages were not instrumented in frozen baseline; do not treat them as zero cost.
Server independent per-operation middleware counters cover both delivery binaries, including requests not hooked by the old native client.
